heading: Facilitation

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Except as otherwise provided by law (including section 101(a) of the PROGRESS for Indian Tribes Act), the Secretary shall interpret each Federal law and regulation in a manner that facilitates—

children.text: the inclusion of programs in funding agreements; and

children.heading: Request
children.text: An Indian Tribe may submit to the Secretary a written request for a waiver of applicability of a Federal regulation, including—
an identification of the specific text in the regulation sought to be waived; and

children.heading: Determination by the secretary
children.text: Not later than 120 days after receipt by the Secretary and the designated officials under paragraph (4) of a request under paragraph (1), the Secretary shall approve or deny the requested waiver in writing to the Indian Tribe.

children.heading: Extensions
children.text: The deadline described in paragraph (2) may be extended for any length of time, as agreed upon by both the Indian Tribe and the Secretary.

children.heading: Designated officials
children.text: The Secretary shall designate one or more appropriate officials in the Department to receive a copy of the waiver request described in paragraph (1).

children.heading: Grounds for denial
children.text: The Secretary may deny a request under paragraph (1) upon a specific finding by the Secretary that the identified text in the regulation may not be waived because such a waiver is prohibited by Federal law.

children.heading: Failure to make determination
children.text: If the Secretary fails to make a determination with respect to a waiver request within the period specified in paragraph (2) (including any extension agreed to under paragraph (3)), the Secretary shall be deemed to have agreed to the request, except that for a waiver request relating to programs eligible under section 5363(b)(2) or section 5363(c) of this title, the Secretary shall be deemed to have denied the request.

children.heading: Finality
children.text: A decision of the Secretary under this section shall be final for the Department.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: Section 101(a) of the PROGRESS for Indian Tribes Act, referred to in subsec. (a), is section 101(a) of Pub. L. 116–180, which is set out as a note under section 5361 of this title.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 93–638, title IV, § 409, as added Pub. L. 116–180, title I, § 101(e), Oct. 21, 2020, 134 Stat. 874.)
